description: A dotnet new template pairing a WolverineFx backend with a React (Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind) frontend: HTTP endpoints, messaging with a transactional outbox, Marten event sourcing or EF Core, validation, SignalR realtime updates, and optional JWT-based Identity. Built entirely on free, open-source libraries. A community template from LibreSharp, not an official WolverineFx/JasperFx package.
title: LibreSharp WolverineFx + React Template
